# Systemia Radar

Product key: systemia-radar
Canonical product: https://systemia-scan-pro.base44.app/
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/systemia-radar/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/systemia-radar/ai-conformance.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- scan my website for problems
- compare my website against competitors
- show where my competitors are beating my website
- create a website competitor comparison report
- monitor my website with weekly rescans
- track website audit changes over time

## Authority

public free website scan and paid competitive-monitoring offer discovery; paid access requires human confirmation and authoritative payment verification

## Commercial state

- Status: source_checkout_wired_live_verification_pending
- Offer: Free website scan · $0 per scan
- Offer: Radar Pro Monthly · $29/month
- Offer: Radar Pro Yearly · $290/year
- Payment state: Source includes checkout, payment webhook, purchase-status and unlock functions; paid state must be independently provider-verified

## Boundaries

- website findings must come from observed scan evidence rather than fabricated LLM opinion
- scores and competitor comparisons do not guarantee rankings, leads or revenue
- weekly monitoring reflects reachable scan data and is not a guarantee of continuous availability
- checkout creation alone does not activate paid access
